reason: A repository of structured, reusable skills that guide AI-agent coding, tool use, execution workflows, context management, and agent-harness evaluation.

summaries.zh: 提供可复用的结构化智能体技能模块，用于指导编码工作流、工具使用、上下文管理和智能体可靠性评估。
summaries.en: Provides reusable structured agent skill modules for coding workflows, tool use, context management, and agent-harness reliability evaluation.

capabilities: Defines reusable structured instructions for AI agent workflows
Guides coding-agent behavior such as framework reuse and minimal custom implementation
Specifies evaluation procedures for agent harness reliability and production readiness
Provides tool-use constraints, failure strategies, output requirements, and quality checklists
Supports loading skills into custom agents, MCP-based agents, and IDE rule systems
